text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot some students asking Bamboo
Memory and
Inari One for help.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So what're ya sayin' exactly? That there's
a ghost
livin' in the mountains near the
academy?

text_block_list.name: Scared Student
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's been coming down all
the way from the mountain to the
school, and it's even
been sighted in the
dorms!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, that sure sounds like a threat
to
academy order!

text_block_list.name: Anxious Student
text_block_list.text:
And a lot of students are losing sleep
'cause
they're so scared it's gonna g-go
into their room...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't worry! If that spookster
shows up, I'll
take care of it right there
and then!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Always reliable, Inari! You're the
embodiment of
chivalry!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But of course!
I can't just sit back eating
popcorn
when there are younger
students in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm gonna do what I can too! Let's
get right
into it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Time to head up the mountain and teach
that
ghost a lesson!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gotta strike while the iron's haunted!
Let's go,
Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaahhhhh! W-wait! Lemme go! I'm
not
mentally prepared yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory grabs a panicked Inari
One's
hand and races off in a whirlwind...
Or so it seems,
but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoops! Almost forgot! You there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It'd be unethical to have students
climbing up the
mountain
unaccompanied! So...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We need you to come with us as our
guardian!
Please and thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And so I find myself getting dragged
along to
the mysterious mountain.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, Bamboo? I feel like someone's
been
watching us this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Worry not! If it's just looking at us,
that
must
mean it's too scared to make a
move!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
R-right! Yeah! Nothing's gonna scare us
if we stick
togeth—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-w-w-wait a minute! When did it get
so dark?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It continues to get darker and darker
around us,
intensifying the indescribably
sinister atmosphere!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, something's coming.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-w-we gotta get outta here! This place
is way
too creepy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oooh, it's getting closer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Now! Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: HAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Using her bamboo sword, Bamboo Memory
delivers a single blow to a tree.
Upon doing so, the sinister atmosphere
enshrouding the area
disperses instantly.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes! Looks like I landed that one!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
S-so we're safe now? Thank goodness...
By the
way, I had no idea you knew how
to exorcise
ghosts.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who said I did?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But don't worry! When it comes to
fighting, it's all
about spirit! If you scare
off your opponent, that makes you the
winner!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...At least that's what they said in this
show I
watched ages ago! Glad I
managed to teach ol'
ghosty a lesson!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...At least that's what they said in this
show I
watched ages ago! Glad I
managed to teach ol'
ghosty a lesson!
choice_data_list: Anyway, that's a relief, isn't it?
You two made a great duo.
You two made a great duo, didn't you?
...What if the ghost doesn't get s...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then I would've teamed up with Inari
and blown it
away with a wave of guts!
choice_data_list: Anyway, that's a relief, isn't it?
You two made a great duo.
You two made a great duo, didn't you?
...What if the ghost doesn't get s...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...That would've been cooler, though.
Imagine all
the passion! Still, all's well
that ends well!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
B-Bamboo... You're seriously out of your
mind,
y-you know that? Geez...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I guess the ghost backed off without
any fuss,
so that worked out okay for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like we walked a fine line between
life and
death, but it seems as though
the case has been
closed.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A g-great duo? I was too scared to even
do
anything! I don't need your
consolation...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! You were
the one who volunteered to defeat the
ghost and protect
the younger students
in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I just brought the energy so I wouldn't
embarrass
you! This was all you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
B-Bamboo... Gaaah! I sure am lucky to
have
someone like you around!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... If any other ghosts start
acting up
at the academy, just leave it to
us!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You said it! Now everyone at the
academy can
live their lives in peace!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was real touch-and-go for a
second
there. I'm glad you were with me,
Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ghost or no ghost, no one's disturbing
the peace!
Not as long as Inari and I are
around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following their successful exorcism,
Bamboo Memory and Inari One are
flooded with requests
to handle other
ghosts.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You said it! Now everyone at the
academy can
live their—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's up? Cat got your tongue?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... It just feels like that unsettling

atmosphere's still lingering somehow...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe that ghost still hasn't learned
its lesson!
I'll have to give it another
thwack for good
measure!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
H-hold up! Don't leave me behind in this
creepy
place!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Mission complete! Okay, let's head back
to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't wanna stick around here
for too
long.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's up with you? You look like
you're
carrying a huge load or
somethin'...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So anyone with enough determination
can scare ghosts away... But what if
you're too terrified to
show that
determination?
